[SWS_DM_01063] Transmission error behavior
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04215
⌈
In case of a
PDID
transmission error, the DM shall use always the same order of
periodicDIDs per client. Transmission errors shall not influence this order, the DM shall
continue to retry the transmission and start the next
PDID
only after the
PDID
was
transmitted successfully.
⌋
7.3.2.8.13 Service 0x2C – DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier
